name: Hôtel Barrière Le Carl Gustaf Saint-Barth
positioning: All-suite hillside hotel on the heights of Gustavia overlooking Shell Beach, now marketed by Barrière as Fouquet's Saint-Barth
best_for: Couples who want a suite with its own terrace or pool and views over Gustavia and the Caribbean Sea
Groups or families who want a private villa with chef and butler services

facts.text: The hotel sits on the heights of Gustavia, overlooking Shell Beach.
Barrière markets the hotel under the name Fouquet's Saint-Barth.
The suites were designed by Gilles & Boissier and have views of Gustavia and the Caribbean Sea.
Each accommodation is Colonial-inspired and has an outdoor terrace, a private pool, or both.
Villa Diane sits on a hillside overlooking St Barths and has a private plunge pool perched atop the island.
The Suite Lucien Duplex has a roof terrace and a hot tub.
The spa works in exclusive partnership with Biologique Recherche and offers personalized face and body rituals.
Access to the spa is included in a stay, and there is a yoga studio with indoor and beachfront sessions.
Shellona is the hotel's seaside restaurant, with a menu created by Greek executive chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
Beefbar combines meats such as Wagyu, Black Angus and Kobe with fresh seafood and plant-based dishes.
Cribs are free on request, and some suites or villas can be combined for families or groups.
Pets are welcome, subject to specific conditions.

highlights.text: Every suite or villa is Colonial-inspired, with an outdoor terrace, a private pool, or both, in suites designed by Gilles & Boissier with views of Gustavia and the Caribbean Sea.
The Royal Loft has a roof terrace at the top of the main house.
Villa Diane has a private plunge pool perched atop the island, and a tailor-made Villa Diane offer includes private chef and butler services.
Guests can explore St Barth through a personalized itinerary, including catamaran trips, hikes such as the one to Colombier, and sunset yoga sessions.

considerations.text: The hotel is on the heights of Gustavia overlooking Shell Beach rather than directly on the sand.
Custom excursions such as catamaran, seabob and flyboard are at additional cost.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location involves walking on inclined paths.
